admission.justification: Closure settlement, generation fencing across all held-store writers, lockless missing-store reads, and build-checked shared-store reconciliation jointly guarantee that closed seats lose no waiting text and never recreate removed stores or folders.

guarantee: Closing a seat (by recorded retirement, rejected start, closing archive mark, or host-confirmed archival or absence — never by stopped status alone) or superseding its launch generation records waiting messages with exact text in the launch receipt before unlinking its store. Every subsequent held-store write (role messages, product messages, developer delivery, tick, sweep, drain, or late close) refuses closed or superseded generations without creating a store or folder, sends preserve their selected generation, and counts of missing stores create nothing. Opt-in runtime_install previews settlement counts without mutating server registry files or stores, and on apply settles closed shared stores and removes obsolete locks only after older server builds have stopped.
title: Closed-seat held-store fence and opt-in shared-store reconciliation
